basic_info.description: Tucked away on a charming street, this full-floor Edwardian condo effortlessly combines classic character with modern comfort. Set in a picturesque two-unit building, it's a warm and inviting retreat in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Thoughtfully updated while preserving its timeless details, the home offers a versatile layout perfect for both relaxing and entertaining.    The spacious double-parlor primary bedroom, complete with a cozy fireplace, feels like a private sanctuary, while the second bedroom offers a peaceful escape. At the heart of the home, the central living room is an ideal gathering space, flowing seamlessly into a beautifully remodeled kitchen. Morning light streams through upgraded windows, casting a golden glow over the front rooms and enhancing the home's welcoming feel.    Practical perks include one car garage parking, extra storage, and in-building laundry. And with a Walk Score of 98 and a Bike Score of 93, you're just steps from the Marina's best shops, top restaurants, and scenic parks, truly the best of city living.
